RETAIL_RESIDENTIAL_MORTGAGE.mechanism: Property realization after joint-borrower claim consolidation; junior lien remains a distinct claim

RETAIL_HOME_EQUITY_LINE.mechanism: Second-lien proceeds after separately identified senior mortgage; undrawn line is not default EAD

RETAIL_UNSECURED_INSTALLMENT.mechanism: Unsecured settlement; no property collateral inferred

RETAIL_EDUCATION_LOAN.mechanism: Contractual deferral precedes default; employment-linked settlement is actual cash

RETAIL_AUTO_LOAN.mechanism: Repossessed vehicle proceeds less separate recovery costs; balloon remains in claim

RETAIL_AUTO_LEASE.mechanism: Terminated lease claim and vehicle residual proceeds; asset sale not counted as instalment payment

RETAIL_CREDIT_CARD.mechanism: Revolving drawn balance at default, recoveries after line closure

RETAIL_CHARGE_CARD.mechanism: Full-payment card claim; no invented undrawn revolving commitment

RETAIL_OVERDRAFT.mechanism: Drawn overdraft including documented excess; salary receipts applied once

RETAIL_BNPL.mechanism: Separate purchase receivables consolidated into one obligor claim without duplicate receipts

RETAIL_MICRO_LOAN.mechanism: Actual individual repayments; social group support is not an automatic guarantee payment

RETAIL_SMALL_BUSINESS_FINANCE.mechanism: Firm operating claim separated from owner household; business asset realization distinct from personal income
